Yume Nikki Maker

Create and explore Yume Nikki worlds made by other people!!! Make a world in the level editor, and then choose where to connect your worlds while exploring!


Create

Left Click to add a tile

Right Click to erase a tile

Mouse Wheel to zoom

CTRL + Z to Undo

Explore

WASD/Arrow Keys to move

Z/Enter to interact

1 to use certain effects

9 to wake up

X/Shift to see the author and world name (and also report if you're signed in)
